items.title: Dipke demands Ranka and Das's release in overnight IG reel
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke posted a video reel on Instagram at ~3:48 AM IST, Oct 14 captioned 'Release Ashu & Saurav now!' — a release demand for co-conveners Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das while they were in detention custody (before the 5-day judicial-custody order was passed later that morning). The reel never surfaced in any earlier check.
